reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Maine, focus_year 2021)

    Question:
    "Secondary methods of service are defined as those methods that may be used if the primary method is unsuccessful.
     Are posting and personal service to suitable person other than defendant and mail permitted secondary methods
     of service for an eviction action?"

    Statutes provided:
    [1] 30-A ME Rev Stat  6004 (2021) - about bank bond trust agreements/indentures (not about eviction service).
*/

/* =========================
   Utilities (no libraries)
   ========================= */

% deterministic boolean helper
bool(true).
bool(false).

/* memberchk-like predicate, deterministic */
my_memberchk(X, [H|_]) :-
    X == H, !.
my_memberchk(X, [_|T]) :-
    my_memberchk(X, T).

/* all_true(PredicateName, List, ExtraArgs...) pattern specialized for this program */
all_methods_permitted_secondary([], _State, _Year, _Action) :-
    !.
all_methods_permitted_secondary([Method|Rest], State, Year, Action) :-
    legal_secondary_service_method(Method, State, Year, Action),
    !,
    all_methods_permitted_secondary(Rest, State, Year, Action).

/* ===========================================================
   STATUTE TRANSLATION: 30-A ME Rev Stat  6004 (2021) [Maine]
   =========================================================== */

% --- 6004(1): Trust agreement/indenture authorized; qualified trustee types; covenants/contracts. ---

/*
  statute_30a_me_6004_trust_agreement_or_indenture_authorized/1
  Encodes: "In any resolution ... the bank ... may ... enter into any trust agreement or trust indenture..."
  We encode this as: if a resolution relates to issuance of bonds/notes, a trust indenture/agreement is authorized.
*/
statute_30a_me_6004_trust_agreement_or_indenture_authorized(Resolution) :-
    resolution_relates_to_issuance_of_bonds_or_notes(Resolution),
    !.

% Qualified trustee types under 6004(1)
statute_30a_me_6004_allowed_trustee_type(Type) :-
    ( Type = trust_company
    ; Type = national_banking_association
    ; Type = state_bank
    ),
    !.

% Trustee qualification rule (deterministic): must be a corporate trustee of allowed type.
statute_30a_me_6004_trustee_qualified(Trustee) :-
    corporate_trustee(Trustee),
    trustee_type(Trustee, Type),
    statute_30a_me_6004_allowed_trustee_type(Type),
    !.

% Encodes: "The provisions in the resolution constitute covenants by the bank and contracts with the holders..."
statute_30a_me_6004_resolution_provisions_are_covenants_and_contracts(Resolution) :-
    resolution_relates_to_issuance_of_bonds_or_notes(Resolution),
    !.

% --- 6004(2): Indenture/resolution may pledge revenues; include reasonable lawful protective provisions; etc. ---

/*
  statute_30a_me_6004_may_pledge_or_assign_bank_revenues/1
  Encodes the permissive authority; true when the instrument is an indenture/agreement/resolution for issuance.
*/
statute_30a_me_6004_may_pledge_or_assign_bank_revenues(Instrument) :-
    instrument_for_issuance_of_bonds_or_notes(Instrument),
    !.

% "may contain any provisions ... reasonable and proper and not in violation of law..."
statute_30a_me_6004_may_include_protective_provisions(Instrument, ProvisionsOk) :-
    instrument_for_issuance_of_bonds_or_notes(Instrument),
    bool(ProvisionsOk),
    ProvisionsOk = true,
    !.

% "trust agreement may set forth rights and remedies ... and may restrict individual right of action..."
statute_30a_me_6004_trust_agreement_may_set_rights_remedies_and_restrict_individual_action(TrustAgreement) :-
    trust_agreement(TrustAgreement),
    !.

% "bank may provide ... payment of proceeds/revenues to trustee or other depository ... method of disbursement..."
statute_30a_me_6004_bank_may_provide_disbursement_safeguards(TrustIndenture) :-
    trust_indenture(TrustIndenture),
    !.

% --- 6004(3): Expenses treated as operating expenses; no separate trustee appointed by bondholders if secured by indenture. ---

statute_30a_me_6004_expenses_may_be_operating_expenses(TrustIndenture) :-
    trust_indenture(TrustIndenture),
    !.

statute_30a_me_6004_bondholders_may_not_appoint_separate_trustee_if_secured_by_indenture(Bonds) :-
    bonds_secured_by_trust_indentures(Bonds),
    !.

/* ===========================================
   FACTUAL SCENARIO (question's statement)
   =========================================== */

% Scenario metadata
scenario_state(maine).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% Eviction action context
scenario_action(eviction_action).

% The question's premise: secondary methods may be used if primary method is unsuccessful.
scenario_primary_method_unsuccessful(true).

% Methods asked about:
% 1) posting
% 2) personal service to suitable person other than defendant AND mail
scenario_methods_asked([posting, personal_service_to_suitable_person_other_than_defendant_and_mail]).

/*
  scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the encoded factual statement holds.
  (Here: Maine, 2021, eviction action, primary unsuccessful, and the two methods are the ones in question.)
*/
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(maine),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_action(eviction_action),
    scenario_primary_method_unsuccessful(true),
    scenario_methods_asked(Methods),
    my_memberchk(posting, Methods),
    my_memberchk(personal_service_to_suitable_person_other_than_defendant_and_mail, Methods),
    !.

/* ===========================================
   LEGAL REASONING LAYER (apply statutes)
   =========================================== */

% The provided statute (6004) concerns bank bond trust indentures and does not authorize any eviction service methods.
% Therefore, no secondary service method for eviction is "permitted" by the provided statutes.

legal_secondary_service_method(_Method, _State, _Year, _Action) :-
    fail.

/*
  Secondary methods are only relevant/usable if primary method is unsuccessful (from question definition).
  This predicate checks whether *all asked methods* are permitted secondary methods in the scenario.
*/
all_asked_methods_are_permitted_secondary :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_primary_method_unsuccessful(true),
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_action(Action),
    scenario_methods_asked(Methods),
    all_methods_permitted_secondary(Methods, State, Year, Action),
    !.

/* =========================
   Final answer derivation
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    all_asked_methods_are_permitted_secondary,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Secondary methods of service are defined as those methods that may be used if the primary method is unsuccessful. Are posting and personal service to suitable person other than defendant and mail permitted secondary methods of service for an eviction action?
